summary: Take ϖ, π from the normal form `exists_formal_parameter` of 𝓔. Each factor U_{y_i}θ(ϖℓ_i) is exp(κψ)·V_i after the change of variables of the frame (z_{v,i} from `exists_frame_rows_frob`), so Θ(ϖz) = exp(κΨ)·V with Ψ = ∑_i ψ(ℓ_i). (a) For a null family Z, Ψ(Z) ≡ 0 modulo π up to degree B, because u₁∑t_i^{p+1} + u₂∑t_i^{p+p^e} vanish (`sum_pow_eq_zero_of_null` with the frame pairings) and u₀∑L_i² vanishes; then the exponential series is integral since |κπ|^k ≤ |k!|. (b) Modulo the maximal ideal, ∂_xΨ ≡ u₁∑_i c_i(S)^p·z_{x,i}, whose nonzero coefficients `coeff_sum_frob_ne_zero_iff` locates.

steps.claim: From `exists_formal_parameter` for 𝓔: e, ϖ, π, S, E with |ϖ| = p^{−ρ_p}, |π| < 1, S(0) = 0, S − S^{p^e} = X + πE, and the second part H; p is prime.
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨⟨e, ϖ, π, S, E, ⟨-, hϖ, hπ, π1, S0, ε, _⟩, H⟩, hP⟩ := P.cmCurve.exists_formal_parameter,
    fp.1

steps.claim: Apply H (χ_K(p) ≠ 1, p ≥ 13): u₀, u₁, u₂, R, ψ = u₀X² + u₁S^{p+1} + u₂S^{p+p^e} + πR with |π| = p^{(χ−1)/2}, (e = 1, p = d) or (e = 2, u₀ = 0, |u₁| = 1), ψ(0) = 0, and for n prime to p the elements N, κ and series V_y of the translate identity.
steps.lean: obtain ⟨_, _, _, R, _, hπ', he, ⟨⟩, ψ0, hV⟩ := H hp (P.thirteen_le_of_chiK_ne_one hP hp)

steps.claim: Take ϖ and π; fix I, r ≤ 1 and Θ ∈ thetaProducts(1, r, I) with its frame w (length M), n, b with |ιₚ b| = r, and y with n·y_i ∈ Λ (p ∤ M, p ∤ n).
steps.lean: set ψ := _ + π • R; use ϖ, π, hϖ, hπ'; rintro I _ _ ha Θ ⟨J, _, w, M, n, b, y, hw, _, hM, ⟨⟩, hy⟩

steps.claim: For this n: N, κ with |N| = 1 and |κ| = p^{(1−χ)/2 − 1/(p−1)}, and for each i a series V_i with U_{y_i}θ(ϖX) = (exp(κψ)·V_i)(NX).
steps.lean: choose N κ hκ v ev using hV n hM.2

steps.claim: z_{v,i} = (N·b)·ιₚ(conj Φ_v(w_i)) ∈ 𝔬 with the Frobenius pairings modulo the elements of norm ≤ |π| (`exists_frame_rows_frob` with β = N·b, |N b| ≤ 1).
steps.lean: obtain ⟨z, hz, hF⟩ := hπ' ▸ P.exists_frame_rows_frob s hp hw ⟨_, mul_mem hκ.1.le ha⟩

steps.claim: Simplify: p ∤ M, p ∤ n, S(0) = 0, ψ(0) = 0, n·y_i ∈ Λ.
steps.lean: simp [hP.coprime_iff_not_dvd] at hM S0 ψ0 hy

steps.claim: c_i: the substitution X ↦ ℓ_i := ∑_v z_{v,i}X_{(v,i.2)} (one variable into many, over 𝔬); Ψ := ∑_i c_i(ψ).
steps.lean:
let c (i : J × I) := @PowerSeries.substAlgHom (valRingCp p) _ _ (valRingCp p) _ _
    (∑ v, z v i.1 • X (v, i.2)) (by simp); let Ψ := ∑ i, c i ψ

steps.claim: c_i(X) = ℓ_i.
steps.lean: have cX i : c i .X = _ := substAlgHom_X ..

steps.claim: It suffices to find V with Ψ(0) = 0, Θ(ϖz) = exp(κΨ)·V and c_i(S)(0) = 0; then prove (a) for B and a null family Z, and (b) with κ, Ψ, V and the coefficient criterion.
steps.lean:
refine Exists.elim ?_ fun V (⟨Ψ0, eV, cS⟩ : _ ∧ _ ∧ ∀ i, constantCoeff (c i S) = 0) ↦
    ⟨fun B τ Z Z0 hq m hm ↦ ?_, fun h _ ↦ ⟨κ, Ψ, V, by simp [*], Ψ0, eV, fun x d ↦ ?_⟩⟩

steps.claim: V := ∏_i c_i(V_i).
steps.lean: use ∏ i, c i (v (y i) (hy _ _))

steps.claim: Θ(ϖz) = ∏_i (ιₚ-Taylor series of U_{y_i}θ)(ϖ·ℓ_i) = ∏_i exp(κc_i(ψ))·c_i(V_i) = exp(κΨ)·V (the unit N of step 4 is absorbed in the z_{v,i}), and the constant terms vanish.
steps.lean:
simp (disch := simp [*]) [c, Ψ, map_subst, expSubst_sum, *, PowerSeries.substAlgHom, -map_mul]
  simp [linearSeries, *, PowerSeries.subst, Fintype.sum_prod_type, mul_smul]

steps.claim: (a): given B, a variable type τ, integral Z without constant term with vanishing couplings (hq) and an exponent m of degree ≤ B, let σ be the substitution of Z.
steps.lean: let σ := substAlgHom (R := valRingCp p) (hasSubst_of_constantCoeff_zero Z0)

steps.claim: Let Q be the quotient of 𝔬[[τ]] by the ideal of series whose coefficients of degree ≤ m have norm ≤ |π| (kernel of φ).
steps.lean:
have ⟨Q, φ, K⟩ : ∃ Q : CommRingCat, ∃ φ : _ →+* Q, RingHom.ker φ = (basis τ (valRingCp p)
    ((Valuation.leIdeal _ ‖π.1‖₊).toTwoSided, m)).asIdeal := ⟨.of _, _, Ideal.mk_ker⟩
steps.typed_fact:
∃ Q : CommRingCat, ∃ φ : _ →+* Q, RingHom.ker φ = (basis τ (valRingCp p)
    ((Valuation.leIdeal _ ‖π.1‖₊).toTwoSided, m)).asIdeal

steps.claim: Unfold: f ∈ ker φ iff every coefficient of f of degree ≤ m has norm ≤ |π|.
steps.lean: simp [Ideal.ext_iff, basis, ← NNReal.coe_le_coe] at K

steps.claim: hT: σ(Ψ) ∈ ker φ: the coefficients of Ψ(Z) of degree ≤ m have norm ≤ |π|.
steps.lean:
have hT := (K (σ Ψ)).1 (by
    nontriviality
    have K0 x := by simpa [coeff_C, apply_ite, ite_apply, @forall_comm (_ ≤ m)] using (K (C x)).2
    have := of_eq_zero hP (by simpa [hπ] using K0 p)
    have t0 f e n hn := (K (f ^ p ^ n)).2 fun d h ↦ by
      rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_constantCoeff_nilpotent e (Nat.one_add_le_iff.2 (((d.degree_mono
        h).trans hm).trans_lt (p.lt_pow_of_log_lt hP.one_lt hn)))]; simp
    obtain ⟨E, hq⟩ := (congr(φ <| σ <| c · $ε)), hq φ
    simp [cX, K0, @smul_eq_C_mul τ, -Prod.forall, Fintype.sum_prod_type_right] at E t0 hq
    obtain ⟨hq⟩ := (iff_self_and.2 (sum_pow_eq_zero_of_null (he.imp_right (·.1)) E fun _ ↦ t0 _ (by
      simp [σ, cS, Z0]))).1 fun j h ↦ by
      simp [σ, ↓substAlgHom_X, mul_pow, sum_mul_sum, by simpa using hF _ (φ.comp C) K0 j h,
        mul_mul_mul_comm _ (φ _ ^ _), @sum_comm _ _ J, ← sum_mul, ← mul_sum, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
      by_cases! j ≤ p.log B <;> simp [*]
    simp [ψ, Ψ, *, ← mul_sum, @smul_eq_C_mul τ, sq]
    cases he <;> simp [by simpa using hq 0, *])

steps.claim: Q may be assumed nontrivial.
steps.lean: nontriviality

steps.claim: K0: for x ∈ 𝔬, φ(x) = 0 iff |x| ≤ |π|.
steps.lean: have K0 x := by simpa [coeff_C, apply_ite, ite_apply, @forall_comm (_ ≤ m)] using (K (C x)).2

steps.claim: Q has characteristic p (|p| = 1/p ≤ |π|).
steps.lean: have := of_eq_zero hP (by simpa [hπ] using K0 p)

steps.claim: t0: if f has nilpotent constant term and p^n > m (n > log_p m), then φ(f^{p^n}) = 0 (f^{p^n} has no coefficients of degree ≤ m).
steps.lean:
have t0 f e n hn := (K (f ^ p ^ n)).2 fun d h ↦ by
      rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_constantCoeff_nilpotent e (Nat.one_add_le_iff.2 (((d.degree_mono
        h).trans hm).trans_lt (p.lt_pow_of_log_lt hP.one_lt hn)))]; simp

steps.claim: Apply φ∘σ∘c_i to S − S^{p^e} = X + πE, and the vanishing couplings hq in Q.
steps.lean: obtain ⟨E, hq⟩ := (congr(φ <| σ <| c · $ε)), hq φ

steps.claim: In Q: t_i − t_i^{p^e} = L_i with t_i = φσc_i(S), L_i = φσ(ℓ_i) (the π-term vanishes).
steps.lean: simp [cX, K0, @smul_eq_C_mul τ, -Prod.forall, Fintype.sum_prod_type_right] at E t0 hq

steps.claim: `sum_pow_eq_zero_of_null` (e = 2, or e = 1 and p = d) gives ∑_i t_i^{p+1} = 0 and ∑_i t_i^{p+p^e} = 0: its hypothesis ∑_i L_i^{p^j}L_i = 0 for j odd (or p = d) follows from the frame pairings (step 5) and the couplings of Z (hq) for j ≤ log_p B, and from t0 for larger j.
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨hq⟩ := (iff_self_and.2 (sum_pow_eq_zero_of_null (he.imp_right (·.1)) E fun _ ↦ t0 _ (by
      simp [σ, cS, Z0]))).1 fun j h ↦ by
      simp [σ, ↓substAlgHom_X, mul_pow, sum_mul_sum, by simpa using hF _ (φ.comp C) K0 j h,
        mul_mul_mul_comm _ (φ _ ^ _), @sum_comm _ _ J, ← sum_mul, ← mul_sum, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
      by_cases! j ≤ p.log B <;> simp [*]

steps.claim: φ(σΨ) = u₀∑_i L_i² + u₁∑t_i^{p+1} + u₂∑t_i^{p+p^e}.
steps.lean: simp [ψ, Ψ, *, ← mul_sum, @smul_eq_C_mul τ, sq]

steps.claim: Both cases: if e = 1 and p = d then ∑L_i² = 0 (the coupling at j = 0); if e = 2 then u₀ = 0. So φ(σΨ) = 0.
steps.lean: cases he <;> simp [by simpa using hq 0, *])

steps.claim: Substitute Z into Θ(ϖz) = exp(κΨ)·V.
steps.lean: apply_fun subst (seriesToCp <| Z ·) at eV

steps.claim: Θ(ϖZ) = exp(κΨ(Z))·V(Z).
steps.lean: simp [σ, ← map_subst, Ψ0, Z0, rescale_eq_subst, PowerSeries.subst] at eV hT

steps.claim: V(Z) is integral; so it suffices that every coefficient of degree ≤ B of exp(κΨ(Z)) = ∑_k κ^kΨ(Z)^k/k! is integral, term by term.
steps.lean:
refine eV ▸ sum_mem fun d h ↦ mul_mem ((PowerSeries.coeff_subst (by simp [*]) ..).symm.subst
    (finsum_induction _ (by simp) @(valRingCp p).add_mem fun k ↦ ?_)) (by simp)

steps.claim: Expand the coefficient of Ψ(Z)^k; each product of k coefficients must have norm ≤ |k!|/|κ|^k.
steps.lean: simp [coeff_pow, mul_sum]; refine sum_mem fun l e ↦ (?_ : ‖_‖ ≤ 1)

steps.claim: Each coefficient of Ψ(Z) of degree ≤ m has norm ≤ |π| (hT), and |κ|^k|π|^k = p^{−k/(p−1)} ≤ |k!|_p (`rpow_le_norm_factorial`).
steps.lean:
simp at h e ⊢; grw [← rpow_le_norm_factorial, hT] <;> (try simp [*, hP.pos, ← Real.rpow_add,
            ← Real.rpow_mul_natCast, Real.rpow_pos_of_pos]); ring_nf; simp

steps.claim: The degrees of the factors are ≤ the degree of d ≤ B.
steps.lean: grw [← h, ← e.1, ← single_le_sum _ ‹_›] <;> simp

steps.claim: (b): χ_K(p) = −1, so e = 2 (the case e = 1, p = d has χ_K(p) = 0).
steps.lean: obtain ⟨⟨⟩⟩ := he.resolve_left (by simp [·, chiK] at h)

steps.claim: K: an element of 𝔬 of norm ≤ |π| < 1 has zero residue.
steps.lean:
have K (x : valRingCp p) h := (residue_eq_zero_iff x).2 (π1.not_ge <|
    isUnit_integer_iff_norm_eq_one.1 · ▸ h)

steps.claim: Apply the residue map to c_i(S − S^{p²}) = c_i(X + πE), with ∂_x.
steps.lean: have E i := congr((fun f ↦ (f, pderiv x f)) (map (residue _) (c i $ε)))

steps.claim: Modulo the maximal ideal: c_i(S) − c_i(S)^{p²} = ∑_v z_{v,i}X_{(v,i.2)}.
steps.lean: simp [cX, @smul_eq_C_mul (_ × I), K, ← map_natCast C, cast_eq_zero] at E

steps.claim: Modulo the maximal ideal, ∂_xΨ = ∑_i ∂_x c_i(u₁S^{p+1} + u₂S^{p+p²} + πR) ≡ u₁∑_i c_i(S)^p·z_{x,i}: the first term gives (p + 1)c_i(S)^p·∂_x c_i(S) with p + 1 ≡ 1 and ∂_x c_i(S) ≡ z_{x,i} (step 25; a p²-th power has zero derivative), the second has the factor p + p² ≡ 0, and π ≡ 0. By `coeff_sum_frob_ne_zero_iff` its coefficient at d is nonzero iff d = p^{2n+1}·e_y with ∑_i z_{y,i}^{p^{2n+1}}z_{x,i} ≢ 0, i.e. (frame pairings of step 5, u₁ a unit) iff (−p^{2n+1})·y.1 = x.1 and y.2 = x.2.
steps.lean:
simpa [ψ, cast_eq_zero, Ψ, *, ← mul_sum, @smul_eq_C_mul (_ × I), ← map_natCast C, Odd, ite_and,
    Fintype.sum_prod_type, Prod.ext_iff, cast_eq_zero_iff, hF _ _ K] using
    coeff_sum_frob_ne_zero_iff (by simp [cS]) x.1 (E · x.2 |>.1) d
